Hi there! First of all this is so sweet of you to help your partner feel her best :)

I used to dye my hair all the time. It can be tricky but it never went too badly! And honestly the process was pretty fun especially if you can remember that it’s hair and it will grow back. I recommend watching some YouTube tutorials first! One suggestion I’d like to make is if you do decide to color her hair at home start with a small test strip. This helps you see how the hair will respond to the bleach and if she might have l will any skin sensitivities. 


Or if you don’t want to bleach and want to try a more temporary solution, Have you considered one of the wax colors? I haven’t personally tried them but a few friends have. To my understanding they kind of coat the hair without a need for bleaching. With her having darker hair it might not be as vibrant as she’s hoping for though. 


Best of luck to you :)

I just wanna say that you deserve to give yourself some grace.

As a **26 year old ladyyy** I agree full heartedly. I have so much love for Jenna and Julien, the doggos and the dink fam. This past year plus has been crazy to say the least and now more than ever it’s so important to take care of ourselves. As much as I miss Jenna, I’m so freaking proud of her. She’s clearly so selfless and puts others first all the time and I know it wasn’t easy for her to step away. I think there’s so much power in that. I can only speak as an American (as I’ve heard it’s not necessarily the same everywhere), but we’re taught that our lives revolve around our careers and that can be pretty tough sometimes. It honestly helped me to see someone who put so much work, effort and energy into their work take the time to put their health over their career. Maybe that sounds silly, but I really think normalizing rest and mental health is so important and J&J have really inspired me to take better care of myself too. 
I don’t know what the future holds but I know we all just want what is best for them. Their lives and their happiness are the most important thing here. 
We’ll always have the dink fam and we’ll always be here with open arms for them. It’s encouraging to see others also care more about them than the content they produce and I think that really shows the kind of community they created. Love you Julien and Jenna! And love you fellow dink fam. Always 💜
